proposed_core_edits.reason: The existing all-\(x_0\) lemma \(\mathrm{lem:closed\mbox{-}regime\mbox{-}fixed\mbox{-}point\mbox{-}upper}\) proves the same estimator envelope and \(C\rho_n\) conclusion uniformly for every fixed known \(x_0\in[0,1]^d\), including \(x_0=0\), and also records the no-logarithm elbow specialization. Thus \(\mathrm{thm:total\mbox{-}upper}\) is a strictly redundant legacy node; deletion with replacement preserves every live inbound dependency while allowing the pipeline to remove its generated write-up block and rebuild reverse dependency metadata.
